detail: The national inventory describes 13 bays and three storeys over basement, advanced terminal towers, nap-rendered Gothic dressings, timber sashes, crenellated parapets, recessed slate roofs and octagonal clay chimney pots.
National site inventory records restored 1880 Mackenzie & Moncur conservatory, older service ranges, courtyard outbuildings, and the dome for ornamental plants.
The county documents the standing house on a sloping Irish Sea coastal escarpment and its rose and walled gardens.
The estate identifies the castellated country house and Victorian glasshouses in the rose garden.
